 Predicted Alaves line-up according to the sports press 
 JOSE A. DURáN 
 Fantasy LaLiga expert 
 13 HOURS AGO / 2 min read 
 The Vitoria side travel to Sevilla on Friday after going seven league games without a win and suffering a heavy defeat against Barcelona. Quique Sanchez Flores still has two injury absentees, and the main specialist outlets differ on several positions in the line-up.
 Photo: LaLiga Comuniate

 Deportivo Alavés 
 Seven matches without a win leave Deportivo Alaves with no choice but to respond on their visit to Sevilla this Friday. The blue-and-whites head into the game on the back of the heavy 6-1 defeat against Barcelona and will be looking to rediscover the early-season form they showed at the start of the campaign.
 The side coached by Quique Sanchez Flores also need to improve their attacking output if they are to get back to winning ways and create some breathing space above the relegation zone. The fixture is from matchday 12.
 The Alaves boss will also be without Mikel Rodriguez and Facundo Garces . Both are continuing their respective recovery processes after suffering anterior cruciate ligament ruptures.
 Alaves' predicted line-ups
 The specialist media covering the Vitoria club have put forward the following line-ups for the match against Sevilla.
 EL CORREO: Sivera; Angel Perez, Jonny, Tenaglia, Koski, Abde Rebbach; Blanco, Pablo Ibanez, Denis Suarez; Toni Martinez and Lucas Boye.
 MARCA: Sivera; Novoa, Tenaglia, Koski, Yusi; Angel Perez, Blanco, Pablo Ibanez, Rebbach; Mariano and Lucas Boye.
 AS: Sivera; Angel Perez, Valentini Tenaglia, Koski, Abde Rebbach; Carles Alena, Blanco, Pablo Ibanez; Toni Martinez and Lucas Boye.
